verdict.rationale: The evidence describes a local web UI driven through chat, drag-and-drop and on-video comments, plus a few npm scripts (`npm run doctor`, `npm run post-video`). None of this is a documented public API (HTTP, SDK or programmatic interface) for driving video production. The post-video CLI only schedules or publishes finished videos, so it is an adjacent feature at most and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
